notes.title: Small Patch for version 0.2.5
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

sadly the last update brought some new bugs with it. Thank you all for reporting them!
The following issues are fixed with this patch:

[list]
[*] Terminal cannot be deleted if schedule wasn't opened once since building the terminal.

[*] Achievement for scheduling a flight wasn't awarded.

[*] Clicking "Do not show again" in the Tutorial caused the buttons in the tutorial to not work.

[*] Tooltips of deleted buildings just won't disappear.

[*] Multiple ambulances were called for one emergency.

[*] The schedule wouldnt open and close properly if there were no flights ready to be scheduled yet.

[*] The bonus pay for fulfilled contracts wasn't accounted for the statistics.
[/list]

If you encounter more bugs, please let me know via the steam community hub :)

See you
Marcel aka pidibidi

notes.title: Tender, Love and Care - Big Overhaul Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

it's been a while since the last update but today I am happy to announce the newest update for Lil' Airport.

Although I didn't manage to finish every feature originally planned in this release, I hope the features, fixes and overhauls that did make it, improve the overall experience of the game.

So what's in the Update?

[list]
[*] Overhauled the entire contract and scheduling system for flights. I had to get rid of the drag & drop functionality, but it should be much more stable now and not break as easily as the old system.

[*] Overhauled the Tutorial / How To Play. The description of functionalities, buttons, systems, etc. is now more thorough. The "How To Play" will pop up whenever something new is discovered, except it's set to not show anymore.

[*] Added a Tooltip System. Hover over buttons and buildings to see a short description of what they are / do.

[*] UI Panels can now be dragged around the screen and positioned freely.

[*] Changed the Start Screen to make choosing a save game file a bit more thematically approbriate.

[*] Save files can now be deleted.

[*] Save files are being backed up at every start of the game. You can find the last 5 backups in the installation folder of the game in case something broke (e.g. due to a update).

[*] Added the possibility to change the currency in the settings.

[*] You can choose now in the settings if the game should always be in the foreground or not.

[*] You can also choose to play in full screen or windowed mode. Althoug this breaks the whole transparency settings, so better leave it at borderless... :D

[*] Clicking on terminals shows their gate numbers making it easier to eventually delete them by not scheduling flights for those gates.

[*] Increased the capacity of the fuel tanks to 50 times the old capacity. No more micromanaging the tanks. Overhaul of the resource management will come in a future update.

[*] Added a small animation to the fuel tanks.

[*] Added a small animation to the garages.

[*] Fixed a bug where a flood of messages would appear when trying to delete a terminal.

[*] Fixed a bug where too many passengers would lead to harsh frame drops.

[*] Optimized the auto save to have less stutter on change of day.

[*] Deleted an OpenURL()-Function which caused some security software to see the game as a thread trying to connect to an external service.

[*] Added a small thank you note to the amazing community which provided me whith all the precious feedback to improve the game more and more.

[/list]

Sadly, I did not manage to add terminal customization as I hoped. I made some great progress in the last weeks, after abandoning an older version of the planned system. Here is a little preview of the inside of a small terminal:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992363/ee87f9f2ccd58a59e80f7f033caf1121b6de9857.png[/img]

I am looking forward to all the new bugs being reported after this big update :D

See you soon!

Marcel aka pidibidi

notes.title: A small patch and money graphs!
notes.content:

notes.title: v0.2.4.1 - A hotfix
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I want to thank you all for a succesful launch of the early access version of Lil' Airport. You buying the game, seeing that at all times multiple people are playing it and of course your kind words mean the world to me. 

Also a lot of you pointed out things which dont work, bugs or features they would like to see. While some of those take more time to implement or fix, I managed to put together this hotfix which addresses the following:

[list]
[*] Passengers are no longer clipping through the world on their way to their terminal.
[*] When clicked on a button in the settings menu, this button would turn white with white writing. Now the selected button is blue and readable.
[*] You can now navigate between plots of lang with the arrow keys as well, not just A and D.
[*] There was space missing in the word "Game Notifications".
[*] Costs of buildings are now shown in the format €1.000 or €1,000 depending on your language setting.
[*] The vehicle panel did not work anymore if a garage was deleted. If now a garage is deleted, the vehicles will be "parked" and will show up again once enough spots in garages are available. This system will receive a bigger overhaul in the future.
[*] Planes wouldnt got their terminal but the middle of the screen after an emergency, this is fixed.
[*] The Fire Department is now showing the correct description and costs in the building menu.
[*] The Fuel tank button is less elusive and wont disappear if you want to click on it.
[*] The ambulance is no longer called fire truck in the vehicle panel.
[*] The first message when starting a game is now advising to press ESC to open up the settings and adjust the window position in case the side bar or game are in a weird place.
[*] The game time shouldnt suddenly switch into hyperspeed. There is a bigger underlying issue which caused this which I am still hunting down though.
[/list]

If you found more bugs, weird behaviours or just wish for certain features, let me know! Also make sure to leave a review if you liked the game.

See you
Marcel a.k.a pidibidi

notes.title: Lil' Airport is now available in Early Access!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The steam nextfest of October is behind us and I absolutely overwhelmed by the response Lil’ Airport got during this week. With a budget of 0€ and just as many hours spend on marketing, almost 1000 people played the demo – with an average of 91 players daily. And someone even played it on their Steam Deck.

I want to thank all of you who played or downloaded the demo or simply put the game on their wishlist! And a special thanks to all those of you who reached out to me with feedback for improvement or bug reports. I cannot do it without you guys.
All this feedback and some of my ideas made it now into the newest version 0.2.4 of the demo – and this is also the version published in early access on the 24th of October.

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Click on contracts assigned to gates to get details on the runtime left and the option to cancel them for a fee. The fee is based on the runtime left.
[*] Medical Emergencies! Research and build the firestation to get access to ambulances which help clear the runway whenever a plane comes in with a medical emergency.
[*] Adjust the position of the game! In the settings you find the option to adjust the position of the screen. You can change the height of the landscape to accommodate for your size of taskbar (or of you have no horizontal task bar at all) and you can move the position of the main menu bar left or right, wherever it fits you best.
[*] Close menus quicker by clicking the right mouse button.
[*] For the Demo: Each day a notification reminds you how many in game days are left of the demo.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the demo would end already after 21 in game days instead of 28.
[*] Fixed a bug where fulfilled contracts would cause an error stopping any more flights from coming in.
[*] Fixed a bug where the auto assign function would break (I am still suspicious about this function though… I have my eye on you, auto assign!)
[*] Fixed a bug where the runtime of a contract would already be counting down even with the contract to being taken and assigned to a gate.
[*] Fixed a bug where researched items will still show up in the research menu.
[*] Fixed a bug where buildings could only be build on the first screen/plot even if the second screen/plot is unlocked.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game couldn’t be quit after the demo ended.
[*] Fixed a bug where the warning for a fuel tank being empty was only shown once and not again if the tank is empty again.
[*] Fixed a bug where the unlocking of the second screen/plot wouldn’t be saved.
[*] Fixed a bug where the water FX of the fire truck would spray in the wrong direction.
[*] Fixed a typo where in the description of the garage it states that it provides 5 slots although it provides 3 slots.
[*] Fixed a typo in the Airline Name “DefaultWIng” to “DefaultWing”.
[*] Only Demo: Fixed a Typo where the word “demo” would be spelled “dem” in the start screen message.
[/list]
Who knows if anyone reads this, but I hope the game is now an even better experience for you guys.
Some of things I planned for the first updates after the early access release:
[list]
[*] Terminal hub for passengers to arrive and drop their package
[*] Monorail! It can connect the Hub with terminals
[*] Tunnels – serving as a spawn point for outside connections like busses and trains.
[*] An necessary overhaul of the statistics menu
[/list]

I am looking forward to see you guys again. And make sure to share some screenshots of your airports on steam (just make sure the window in the background is not incriminating – privacy is important!) 

See you
Marcel a.k.a. pidibidi

notes.title: Lil' Airport Demo v.0.2.1 - a hotfix
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I just pushed an update for the Lil' Airport Demo. This update is a small hot fix for some bugs that were reported to me (you can do so via the steam community hub or per mail to mail@pidibidi.com)

[h2]New Version:[/h2]

[h3]Gameplay changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added fences to the boarders of the buildable world (especially interesting for wide screen users). Fence disappear if additional plot of land / screen is unlocked via research
[*] Garage is now available from the beginning and fire station and fuel tank can be research from the start, reducing time needed to finally get them vehicles rolling
[*] slightly reduced research time for medium sized terminal
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed UI scaling when played on wide screen resolution.
[*] Tutorial is now shown correctly next to the buttons it describes even at wide screen resolution
[*] FIxed issue, where game cannot be exited as intended after demo reached its end
[*] Fixed issue, where buildings were locked to be built on the first screen except with work arounds
[*] Fixed issue, where certain already researched things would still show up in the research panel but with negative research time
[/list]

I want to thank anyone who takes the time to play the game and especially to those reporting bugs, issues and feedback!

See you soon!
Marcel a.ka. pidibidi
